description: bash: an untracked file whose name is not UTF-8 is left out of the snapshot, so the snapshot stays valid and the file the command changed is still checked
setup: git add -A && git commit -qm init && printf 'x = 1\n' > $'src/bad\xff.py' && printf 'y = 1\n' > $'src/odd\xe9.md'

steps.sh: sed -i 's/return 1/# one · two\n    return 1/' src/a.py && printf '# c · d\n' >> $'src/bad\xff.py'

contains: src/a.py may not follow the comment conventions
